items.title: I am pleased to nominate Eric Hamilton to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the District of Nebraska. A sixth generation Nebraskan, Eric previously served as Solicitor General of the State of Nebraska. He is a proud graduate of Stanford Law School and the University of Nebraska, and clerked for the highly respected Judge Thomas Hardiman of the Third Circuit. The incredible people of Nebraska are lucky to have a fighter like Eric join the Federal Bench. Congratulations Eric! President DONALD J. TRUMP
